'''Spaceworld''' was a source of entertainment on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A [[Spaceworld (poster)/Legends|series of posters]] were put up around [[Galactic City/Legends|the city]] in order to promote it.<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref>
